text:
V1 is one Next.js 16 application with framework-light TypeScript domain modules. Optional live planning uses the OpenAI Responses API with strict Structured Outputs, store false, and Zod validation. The separate Python clipper uses transcripts, creator memory, callback scoring, ffmpeg rendering, and quality checks. Demo state is seeded in process and distribution is simulated for a reliable judge run.

text:
All three stages are implemented in prototype form. Before the stream, Afterplay uses saved creator context, platform data, history, and an approved experiment. During the stream, Riff follows the live context and can speak. After the stream, Afterplay carries the moment into clipping, memory, approval, results, and the next experiment. Production hardening and real platform credentials remain future work; the core workflow is already built.
